notes.title: Version V1.200.25
notes.notes:
Hello executives, a few bugs were brought to my attention so here are them fixed.

C4 now kills the CEO
The power screen bars will no longer move on their own
Fixed Iron extractor upgrade exploit 
Fixed chat system so that clicking while typing no longer sends the message
Thorium crystals/Iron chunks issue with being picked up has been fixed
Executrons can no longer get inside enemy vehicles
CEO can carry on building items from the security control room once the main office has exploded
Buggy’s have been slow down
Base design has been changed so that you should not be able to build a corridor leading into a wall.
The orbital laser will now blow up shielded units.
The audio on some explosions has now been fixed so you can no longer hear it from the other side of the map


Should you find any more bugs please post them and if possible along with the output log (info on how to do this can be found in the forums)

Executive Assault 2 is coming along nicely with closed beta testing going on at the moment, follow my blog and website for more information.

Just to clarify few things, remember I am a team of 1, governments and Steam take percentages of revenue, I cannot live off one game for the rest of my life (this isn't Minecraft :P ).

I wish you all the best :)

Rob

notes.title: Version 1.200.16
notes.notes:
Hello Executives, at last the version 1.2 patch is out. The graphics have been updated to make use of the latest lighting engine within Unity and a lot of bugs have been fixed that were ruining the game.

Here is a list of changes:

Better graphics across the board using latest Unity graphics engine.
CEO now dies when coming into contact with water.
64-bit
Missiles now have a 60 second cool down timer to stop spamming
AI CEO will now shoot you if you enter the office.
Lightning gun now costs more and takes longer to research.
Upgraded the research tree to look a bit nicer.
Transport ships being blown up won’t break the game.
Can now select unit using its tactical icon.
Sticky keys no longer causes run issues
Planes on Cindar should fly about better.
Red blob does not appear in MP when targeting with long range weaponry
Added Pylon Cap to stop pylon spamming
Sorted out corridor loop issue.
Lowered health of tricruiser
Raised health of Gigantilator
High end weapons have now had their research times increased.
Increased starting power to 40 to give you a better start.
Various weapons have been rebalanced.
Guns shouldn't come out backwards.
Gigantilator Emblem rotates with torso
Multi rockets no longer hurt your team mates.

If you have been testing it please make sure to opt out of the beta build.

A tiny fraction of you may be concerned about the 64-bit conversion, bottom line is that to get all these great new features and less crashes it needs to be 64-bit (it's the year 2017). If you are somehow still running at 32-bit then don't worry you will be play the game but only at version 1.199.92. You will know you are on the latest update when you see a different start background.

I understand there are still a few more minor issues that need addressing but they will come later.

Thank you to those who continue to support the game, your messages really cheer me up and spur me on to fix things and complete the currently worked on sequel.

One final thing, as much as I would love to add you all as friends I unfortunately cannot accept random invites.

All the best.
Rob

notes.title: Version 1.199.9
notes.notes:
Hi Executives,
This patch is mainly to address a few little issues with the game

Updated a few research icons
Cluster rocket deals damage again
Cluster rocket now takes 4 minutes to research
Reduced Cluster rocket damage.
When in FPS mode you should no longer go flying into the air, i have tested this a multitude of times so if its still happening please let me know.

I think a few new maps are needed, if you have any suggestions please let me know.

The next patch will most likely go straight to straight to 1.2 else its just going to start looking silly.

I am also aware of a few network problems when people disconnect so will be looking at improving that in the next patch along with a few UI fixed, also I believe there is an issue with the gate and the energy barrier.

If there are any more issues or questions please don't hesitate to post about them and as always please post your bugs to the bug section and I will take a look.

Cheers
Rob

notes.title: Version 1.1997
notes.notes:
Creeping up to version 1.2...slooowly.

So in this patch the following has been fixed:

Added a Power booster building that will currently give you +10 energy per booster, it can be found at the end of the power capacitor upgrades in the research tree.
Can no longer fly a fighter into the office and shoot the CEO as aircraft will now explode on the first contact.
Asteroid nudge has gone from 3 minutes to 5 minutes
Power Reflector has gone from 5 minutes to 6 minutes.
Thorium crystals now only gives 15 power.
Only one CEO will now appear at the end of the game.
The flag on the back of the Gigantilator is now facing the right way.
When the CEO dies in a self destructed base the game will no longer crash if you keep watching for long enough.
The Desk forcefield button should appear now when researched.
The game has been made a bit more stable.


The reason for adding the power booster was to try and rebalance the game if someone has taken more crystals than you. The basic premise is that its better to get crystals, but if you cant then power boosters are your next option. Please let me know if this helps or if you feel the numbers need balancing a bit more.

Other News
I have always believed in open and honesty about the development of Executive Assault (something that seems to be some what of a rarity on Steam) so would like to use this opportunity to explain why patch releases have been a little slow lately.

I basically want staff and grow my company so that I can produce higher quality games.

However company expansion takes a lot of time and effort so I have been spending a large portion of my time doing this. I am still however dedicated to fixing issues that some of you find in Executive Assault but overall the game is in a very good state.

Hope you understand and realise that Hesketh Studios expanding is a good thing for everyone :) Think of it as long term plans that will eventually most likely lead to an upgrade of Executive Assault and the production of more great games for you to enjoy, it had to happen at some point.

Cheers
Rob

notes.title: Version 1.1991
notes.notes:
Hi all,
Sorry if you were expecting 1.2 but I saw a lot of you had high expectations for something magnificent so decided to keep it in the 1.19's (Yes my version control sux!)

A large selection of issues fixed today:

Personal shield is no longer overpowered.
A plethora of weapons especially for the tanks have now been re balanced, it seems for example the Mini gun was doing 2x more damage then it should of been doing per shot.
Aircraft factory pathfinding has been fixed.
Can now only build 1 security control room.
No longer able to rotate the camera.
You should now be able to hear the base self destruct when not looking at it.
No longer able to sell the powerstation when its cooling has been switched off.
Turrets no longer shoot when you have ran out of power.
Drones no longer teleport.
You should no longer be able to teleport through walls.
Flying into the air and jumping onto roofs as now been limited.
Drones should no longer bob about lost and drunk.
Pressing E should now only work when you are in the specific unit.
Windows 10 logo issues should now be fixed.


If you are still having an issue choosing your logo which also causes the game to crash, your computer may be having issues with Windows so I have added a new button under Options-->Gameplay-->Disable Custom Logos. Reboot the game and this should hopefully fix the issue.

There is a little FPS dropping issue I will be investigating next.

Hope all this helps.

Cheers
Rob

notes.title: Version 1.197
notes.notes:
Version 1.197

Hello executives, new fixes today.

New Features

People were asking for an upgrade to the standard bullets so I have added a heavy bullets, they have a lower rate of fire but do more damage, feel free to let me know if they are any good. My testing has put them just above high energy beam laser in terms of ranking.
The AI's attack strategy has been altered so it wont target just one pick on one player and not attack anyone else even once that player has been destroyed.

Fixes

The hacker bot is back from its winter holiday.
Base will now self destruct if you are in a team game with other players and you die.
Asteroids should now explode on impact.
Tank and aircraft construction costs now show correctly.
Hit counter should only now show on your computer and not on anyone elses
Should no longer be able to build bunkers on top of other bunkers
The AI firing rockets should now predict where the target is.
A few spelling mistakes have been corrected.


Enjoy the new update.

I am thinking on making some changes to the research facility as it has become annoying more then anything. So what I plan to do is make it half the size, Iron chunks will be taken to the same drop off point as the Thorium crystals and the facility will help boost research times. Will see how testing goes.

Cheers
Rob

notes.title: Version 1.14
notes.notes:
Version 1.14
Hi Executives, big patch release tonight so please read carefully whats been added and taken out.

Features & changes

Heskosium and Calcite have been removed to help simplify the resource system.
Research is now boosted from the power screen.
Thorium crystals now yield 20 power.
In FPS mode you now get a damage boost, robots deal 3x damage, vehicles 2x damage.This gives you a better reason to now go into your units.
Bunkers now have turret hard points allowing you to build turrets for the first time anywhere.
The AI's power station can now be self destructed.
Health on the TriCruiser, Gigantilator, Heavy Walker, Fortitude tank has now been increased.
Can now see the weapon damage and firing rate of units in the design menu
New snowy map.

Bug Fixes
TriCruiser now aims correctly in multiplayer
Lifts are now more stable
Driving vehicles inside has hopefully been fixed.

notes.title: Version 1.11
notes.notes:
Hello Executives, since the beta has been going very well and no massive complaints about the multiplayer, I have decided to update everyone to the latest version.

If you are on the ExecuTron branch, please switch back to the standard one by opting out.

This should allow you to play as the ExecuTrons, have much more stable multiplayer games and generally be a much more fun experience.

ExecuTrons allow up to 4 players join your corporation and help you out, if you die as an ExecuTron you will simply respawn back at the HQ. 
You can also play as an ExecuTron with an AI CEO in singleplayer or multiplayer. 

To use the new ExecuTron mode of game play when you host a game, press the enable ExecuTron button in the list and then pick your slot. 

The big slots are for the CEO's and 4 smaller slots under it are for ExecuTrons. 

As always please let me know if you find any issues in the bug section.
I will also be continuing my drive to streamlining the resource system.

Cheers
Rob

notes.title: Version 1.06.0 and Soundtrack
notes.notes:
Hello executives, two announcements today.

Firstly a lot of you have expressed an interest in listening to the music to Executive Assault, therefore I have made available for purchase the soundtrack for you to enjoy which can be found on the store page as DLC, all proceeds will go to the composer.

Second I have been reading your suggestions and comments and have come up with a few solutions that should help make the game more fun.

Gameplay alterations

AI now responds to having its Iron extractor attacked.
The option for meteors to drop Thorium and Calcite has now been added (default to on).
All weapons except the Electron Gun now have their range limited to 500meters. This is just over half way across the map.
CEO now has a new gun: the Disassembler, deals about 150 damage per shot.
CEO glock is now more powerful.
To stop people using corridors as indestructible walls I have introduced a corridor limit which goes up by 2 every time a building is constructed. I have also increased their Iron cost from 100 to 750. Finally they can now be destroyed using the Orbital Laser only.
Large turrets now cost 800 iron
Tank factory now takes 3 minutes to research
Tank factory now costs 3500 iron.
Pulse weapons have proper target prediction rather than tracking to help makes things more fair
Pressing Shift+F12 now shows the ping in multiplayer games.
Damage done by minigun and phased mass rifle has been decreased.


Fixes

A random crash has now been fixed which was being caused by announcements.
AI now rebuilds its Iron Extractors
A second meteor no longer comes down soon after the first one.
Chat window now fixed in the multiplayer game setup screen.
Pressing Shift+F12 shows ping
Can no longer drive vehicles into corridors.
You can now direct connect to password protected games.
Unit that come out of the portal over multiplayer no longer stutter.
You can now rebuild the powerstation after it has exploded.
Basic beam laser now does correct amount of damage.


A big thank you to everyone who has brought the game and have been patient while all these little niggly issues are fixed, means a lot to me that you have stuck with it while I continue to improve the game.

I will be looking at adding weapon info so that you know exactly how much damage everything does as well as improving the AI a bit more.

Cheers
Rob

notes.title: Version 1.05.1
notes.notes:
Hello Executives, just a small patch today just to help smooth out gameplay a little which includes:

Added pause button to options menu, also 'P' pauses game.
Group selecting units now uses CTRL and not Shift.
Attack and Guard commands now work when you click on units.
Version control has been added for multiplayer games so you cant accidently join a game of a different version.


I am currently working on a guide to help explain some of the basics of the game just in case you prefer reading rather then watching the in game tutorial videos.

I am also working on getting the ExecuTrons out too so you can enjoy some games with them. They are going to take a lot of work getting them all balanced so may do some open beta testing.

In case you missed the memo, an ExecuTron is a player controlled FPS only unit you can play as while the CEO builds and controls the army. If you explode while being an ExecuTron you will simply be rebuilt back at the HQ to fight another day.

The current idea is to have the CEO and up to 4 ExecuTrons can join him in helping to defeat the other CEO's who can also have up to 4 ExecuTrons.
I am also setting it up so that you can join the AI CEO too, so if you just fancy shooting stuff then you can leave it up to the AI to build your base.

When joining an ExecuTron game you will only be able to do so at the beginning when it is being setup, no joining mid game.

Cheers
Rob

notes.title: V1.01.0 Update and launch announcement
notes.notes:
Greetings executives, hope you are all enjoying the game?

Thanks to everyone who have been really helpful in the forums and pointed out a few launch day issues. The following has been corrected:

Music in the main menu now responds global music volume slider.
You can now remap the keyboard controls to better match your needs. This may also fix an error some people are having where they are constantly running left.
Trion Cannons should no longer be targeted by members of your own team.
You can now build iron extractors on iron patches the computer is going for too.
Mineral scan now lasts 20 seconds.


Urgent issues to be fixed:

A NAT facilitator error that crops up while connecting in multiplayer. The current work around is to restart the game (that may include the people joining you too).
Doors can sometimes be bypassed by units.
Overhaul the wiki page and help so that the game is easier to understand.

Features to add:

Some sort of formation system.
Stealing of crystals

There are a few more bugs here and there which I am currently scouring the forums looking for. If you do find any, please please please post to the bug sub forum else I might miss it in the general discussions.

I am also looking into an automated way of submitting bug reports so that you don't have to email me your log files, this will help with the occasional crashes that a few of you seem to be experiencing.

Also thank you to all of you who are making suggestions too, I may not answer all your posts but I do read as many as I can since you have taken the time to write them.

All the best
Rob

notes.title: Version 0.87 - Hackerbot and updates
notes.notes:
Hello Executives,

This update will add the Hackerbot. Researched under SpecOps and constructed at the robot factory directly from the command interface, this cloaked unit can sneak past enemy units undetected and will eventually be able to cause havoc.

Armed with its Hackpad, it can currently hack open doors, forcefields and the base door. This can only be done from direct control mode.

If the Hackerbot gets too close to an enemy unit, there’s a chance it may be detected. Also if the Hackerbot is shot, it will loose its cloak permanently. You can only have 1 Hackerbot at a time.

I have also added to the Powerstation and the robot factory controls that you wouldn't want the enemy to touch.

In the Powerstation if the cooling is switched off, it will cause the reactor to go into meltdown. You will then have 2 minutes to run down to the controls and switch the cooling back on before the reactor explodes in a small thermonuclear explosion. This explosion will destroy the Powerstation and kill any units within its 500meter radius. Only the CEO can switch the cooling back on. (This feature is only available on human built Power stations)

The robot factory has a few controls too as mentioned in the last patch allowing you to manufacture troops for your team.

Both are slightly experimental in terms of gameplay so I would love your feedback.

I have also added weapon animations, so you actually look like you're firing a gun now.

As always there are optimizations to help improve gameplay and performance.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Version 0.85 - Allies and Cooperation.
notes.notes:
Now you can not only join forces with rival corporations but also have cooperative multiplayer games against the AI!

In the game creation screen simply click on an open slot to choose the AI you want to play against just like in single player, also choose which team you would like to be on by toggling the number on the side. Let me know how this all goes as it's all a little experimental.

Added extra research for the Iron extractor. Now you can upgrade its armour, output and even throw a shield over it.

Selling now returns 50% Iron.

Basic lasers now have a new animation, let me know what you think.

I have also optimized a few more scripts to help speed things up, although you may still experience slow down when you are playing against 3 other AI’s. Will endeavour to continue to speed things up.

A little bug may have crept in where the interface might not appear, if this happens please let me know which one. To get around this you just need to wobble the mouse over where it should be. Also some input boxes may not display correctly. Both these issues are due to updates in the Unity software and have been reported.

Hope you enjoy the new add-ons and have a great weekend.

Cheers,

Rob.

notes.title: Version 0.82
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Graphical upgrades!

This patch will update the robot factory, corridors, vehicle factory, drone fabricator, air factory, security control room and power station with new graphics, do let me know what you think.

This patch should also help speed things up as I have gone through various scripts and graphics to help make them more efficient.

One final note and a little surprise for you all, I have begun the basics for the hacking system.

If you go into your company information you should see a company password box. This will allow you to setup the password for all your terminals. You will need to remember this if you want to access any of your facilities from the FPS mode.

Now if you press 'SHIFT' in FPS mode you will enter interaction mode which will bring up the mouse cursor allowing you to interact with command consoles. The only structure that has the system implemented at the moment is the Robot Factory with the following options:

Reset Exit Point - The exit point will be reset to its original position in front of the factory.
Activate Alarm - Sets off the facility alarm and calls all nearby friendly units to your location.
Construct Basic Unit - Constructs a basic unit under your command, resources will be deducted from the owner of the factory.

This is all very experimental so please let me know what you think.

Will be continuing graphical updates as well as smoothing out gameplay. We also have our first submitted video on the community hub, including a lovely demonstration of the Gigantilator in action as well as custom logos, go check it out!

Cheers
Rob

notes.title: Version 0.75
notes.notes:
Excited to announce I have added a tutorial, let me know what you think? Its not set in stone so if you have any suggestions, please let me know.

When you first start Executive Assault now a video tutorial will play at opportune moments during gameplay explaining what to do. This tutorial can be turned off in the options menu. It will be defaulted to 'On' for all players.

There are a load of issue fixes too:

You can now repair extractors
Added a heavy indoor turret
You can now see what weapons are assigned to each unit.
Added mouse sensitivity and invert for direct control mode
Jeeps can no longer be driven inverted
Temperature and armour have been removed and replaced with a simple damage and health system, meaning all the weapons now do totally different amounts of damage.
The turret alignment HUD on tanks no longer appear on bots.
Walkers no longer over tilt on terrains in direct control mode.
Mineral scan no longer breaks the minimap
Timed explosives now have a 20 second countdown
The robot you were controlling no longer runs back to its original position
The Emergency desk forcefield HUD should not appear in RTS mode now.
Airplanes no longer have issues attempting to fly underground
Calcite now reduces research times by 14% and not 10%
Tanks now hug the terrain.
The research facility now takes 1:30 to research instead of 3 minutes.
The AI CEO will no longer get distracted by something else and send his forces away mid attack
Audio on vehicles no longer break.

Let me know if you find any balancing issues as it has all been changed.
AI improvements will be coming soon.

Cheers
Rob

notes.title: Version 0.74
notes.notes:
Lots of new fixes tonight:

The options menu can now be pinned to be always up, this is done from the options menu under gameplay.
When an AI CEO dies, his ghost will no longer keep playing.
The explosive pulse weapon now deals the correct damage of 10, and not 100 (extra zero sneaked in there)
You can now shoot through the bunker dome shield
Leg upgrade now affects first person view.
You can no longer stack towers on top of other towers
You can no longer build multiple power plants by holding down shift.
Drone factories are now even more robust.
The Drone returning resources system has been adjusted so that it is hopefully now robust.
I have removed the wide laser beam for the time being until I have decided how to make it work properly.
Asteroids no longer crash down the moment the game starts.
Internal structures and artillery now cost the correct amount.
The AI now rebuilds structures that it was planning on building in the first place if it's drone is destroyed.
You can now only build 1 Gigantilator, there's a reason it has its own theme music.
Current AI now take a bit longer to start sending troops your way.
 

Just wanted to say that the feedback has been amazing, thank you all so much for taking the time to test the game and to support the development of Executive Assault. Still more issues to sort out, but the list is a lot smaller since launch day.

Will be addressing weapon/armour damage soon, as well as adding multiple levels of AI difficulty including an easier one, not to mention a tutorial.

Cheers
Rob
